hp.claim: Only actual verified rows with matching sent/acknowledgement and effect proof are checked. Zero verified events claim neither a real dose nor survival.
proofLimitations: The raw producer does not persist send monotonic time, receipt cursor or quantityBefore. This verifier cannot independently reconstruct the original freshness deadline or the numeric inventory decrease.
Consumed and increased HP remain distinct observations. A consumption proof alone does not claim healing.
No HP event or diagnostic proof contributes to native opportunity, launched attack, dual hit, ACK or original gameplay acceptance.

notes: Every completed300/300/360s phase requires5/5/6 actual complete>=60s windows. Failed and partial phases are never promoted.
Complete original raw and report bytes are SHA-bound; previous failure packages and current originals are never changed.
Raw actor counters and measured-window metric status counts are independently replayed. Frozen verifier additionally validates monitorhistograms and status/projection consistency.
The packettrace is diagnostic and not a new source of damage credit. A future positive probe still needs every original driver two-endpoint900ms evidence gate.
Archive recordings are hash-bound by the frozen collector/public verifier; this tool does not parse recording payloads.
This real probe has no formal capacity acceptance and can only become a precondition to a separately frozen formal run.
